messages:
ana: Quick follow-up from the telemetry rename RFC — we need a safe, reproducible playbook to rename high-cardinality trace/metric fields across SDKs and proxies without breaking cost attribution or dashboards. Thoughts?
jon: +1. Major concerns are: dashboards depending on old names, alert rules, and queries embedded in infra repos. Need a compatibility shim.
sam: Agree. Proposal: introduce stable alias fields while we roll the canonical names. Example mapping:
```
old: model_id -> new: model.name
old: gpu_type -> new: infra.gpu.type
old: request_latency_ms -> new: latency.request.ms
```
lee: Can we do aliasing at the ingest gateway rather than everywhere? That would centralize logic and avoid SDK churn.
maria: Ingest-side aliasing helps, but for cost attribution we need the canonical name present in the trace/envelope earlier so downstream joins don't miss data during sampling. Also SDKs should emit both names for N weeks.
ana: (typo) sorry, ana continuing: Playbook draft: 1) schema mapping table committed to repo; 2) SDKs emit both fields for a deprecation window; 3) gateway also maps aliases so old clients still produce canonical tags; 4) alert/dashboard owners notified and given migration queries; 5) metric/trace backfills evaluated after 2 windows; 6) remove aliases after safe period.
jon: For step 2, we need guidance for when to duplicate vs rename in-line. Duplication increases payload size. Recommend duplicating only for high-value keys used in cost attribution and SLOs. Lower-value keys can be translated at the gateway.
sam: Good heuristic. We should maintain a single source-of-truth list (YAML) indicating field importance: cost-critical, SLO-critical, low. Gateway mapping will consult that.
lee: Edge-case: mobile SDKs with strict payload budgets. For them, we should rely on gateway mapping and a flag in the SDK to opt-in to duplicate emission. Mobile SDK owners need a checklist.
maria: Ops concerns: prometheus metric names will change too. We need to generate a migration table for dashboards: prometheus -> new prometheus name, and automated sed/PRs for common dashboards. Also ensure alert templates use the alias during transition.
jon: We should also think about tag cardinality: renaming something shouldn't create new high-cardinality tag combinations. If new field naming implies nested tags (e.g., infra.gpu.type), we should limit tag explosion by recommending coarse-grained tag values for metrics and keeping fine-grained details only on traces.
ana: (again) small nit: please spell my name correctly 😅
ana: Also want to propose telemetry feature flagging: a rollout flag at customer or cluster level so we can toggle emitting new names per region for gradual rollout and quick rollback.
sam: Implementation checklist for SDK owners: - bump SDK to N+1, emit both keys for entries in the 'dup list' - add runtime flag default off for mobile to avoid size hit - add unit tests verifying alias presence - update README and changelog
lee: For gateway: - implement mapping module that consults YAML mapping table - support mode: passthrough / alias / translate (translate = drop old name, alias = keep both) - expose metrics on mapping hits/misses to detect un-migrated clients
maria: Backfill strategy: run daily job to map historical traces/metrics for the small set of cost-critical keys for the 90-day window used by billing. For metrics we can re-emit aggregated series to the new name. For traces, reindexing may be expensive; prefer live-translation for reads (index-time mapping for new ingests).
jon: Rollout timeline suggestion: Week 0: mapping table + SDK PRs. Week 1-4: SDK canaries + gateway alias mode on test regions. Week 5-8: enable alias mode in prod, monitor mapping hits/misses and dashboard regressions. Week 9-12: coordinate with dashboard owners to update queries. Week 13: switch gateway to translate mode and stop duplicate emission in SDKs.
sam: What about the CI checks? We should add a presubmit that queries the mapping table for changed telemetry names and warns if someone adds a new high-cardinality key without tagging importance.
lee: +1 on CI. Also add a small runtime lint: if new metric name looks like it will spike cardinality (heuristic: keys with dot-depth > 2 + high cardinality suffixes), fail with a soft warning.
maria: Monitoring playbook: create a dashboard that shows counts of events with only-old-name vs only-new-name vs both. Use that to judge when to remove aliases.
jon: Who owns the mapping table and the release of mapping updates? Suggest eng-platform owns schema and publishes to /telemetry/mappings repo; SDK teams request mappings via PR template.
ana: AM eager to help coordinate notifications to other teams and collect dashboard owners list.
ana: (typo again) okay i'm done.
deploy-bot: Test deploy completed for gateway:mapping-module v0.1. Checks: unit=pass, integration=pass.
ana: Thank you. Next action items: ana to draft mapping YAML and PR template; sam to draft SDK checklist; lee to prototype gateway alias mode; maria to draft dashboard migration playbook. Ping me when drafts ready and I'll schedule a 30m sync. :calendar:
jon: Thanks all — let's keep migration windows short and visible. :+1:
